landing.title: Know your soil. Treat the leaf. Protect your family.
landing.subtitle: CropWise reads your Soil Health Card, checks a photo of a sick leaf and gives two honest options side by side – a safe chemical protocol and an organic plan – then helps you move to organic farming over three years.
landing.step1Text: We read N, P, K, pH, EC and organic carbon and mark what is low or high. You check the values.
landing.step2Text: We suggest the most likely disease with a confidence score – and say clearly when we are not sure.
landing.step3Text: Chemical and organic options side by side, doses for your exact field, and safety rules you cannot miss.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the field and the office

f.diagnosisText: Top matches with probabilities and honest low-confidence warnings.
f.safetyText: Toxicity colour, protective gear and harvest waiting time before any dose is shown.
f.organicText: Bio-agents, home-made recipes, traps and soil fixes linked to your card.
f.transitionText: Costs, yield dip and soil carbon recovery for your farm.
f.trackerText: Know exactly when each crop is safe to harvest.
f.languageText: English, हिन्दी and ಕನ್ನಡ, large text and read-aloud.

landing.whyTitle: Going organic overnight can hurt income
landing.whyText1: Soils that received chemicals for years often have little organic carbon and weak soil life. Bio-inputs need that life to work.
landing.whyText2: A phased plan replaces chemicals step by step, keeps yields steady and reaches full organic or IPM practice by year three.
landing.impactTitle: What a phased plan can do
landing.stat1: Lower spend on chemical inputs by year 2
landing.impactNote: Figures are illustrative examples from the demo model, not measured results.
landing.ctaTitle: See the full flow in two minutes
landing.ctaText: Sign in with your mobile number to start.
landing.ctaTextDemo: Use the demo accounts and sample data – no upload needed.
landing.footerAbout: Pesticide Usage Advisory & Organic Farming Awareness System.
landing.disclaimer: Demo prototype. Advice is generated from sample data and is not a substitute for your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture officer.

soil.allGood: Your soil is in good shape.

N.deficient: Your soil needs more nitrogen. Add vermicompost or bio-N.
N.excess: Too much nitrogen. Use less urea.

P.deficient: Your soil needs more phosphorus. Add PSB with rock phosphate.
P.excess: Phosphorus is already high. Skip DAP this season.

K.deficient: Your soil needs more potash. Add wood ash with KMB.
K.excess: Potash is already high. Skip MOP this season.

pH.deficient: Your soil is sour (acidic). Add lime after harvest.
pH.excess: Your soil is alkaline. Add gypsum and compost.

EC.excess: Too much salt in the soil. Give one heavy watering and add farmyard manure.

OC.deficient: Your soil is weak. Add farmyard manure and grow green manure.
